messages:
Aisha Khan: Quick sync — proposing updated acceptance gates for model onboarding focused on tenant-sensitive workloads. TL;DR: add a 'zero-regression' eval, mandatory privacy review, and an egress-compatibility smoke test. 

Ben Liu: Sounds sensible. Can you list concrete thresholds we should gate on? latency, quality delta, and token-cost? :thinking_face: 

Aisha Khan: Yes — suggested initial gates: 
- Quality: no more than 1.5% drop on our standard NLU slices (intent, slot-fill, summarization) vs baseline model.
- Latency: 95th <= 250ms for short prompts (<=128 tokens), p99 <= 600ms for typical traffic.
- Cost: token cost delta <= +10% for warm workloads.

Carlos Martinez: +1. For pinning/rollback: we should require a 14-day soft-pin opt-in window for enterprise tenants before full swap. That lets us measure regressions in the wild. Also need a compatibility shim for embed schemas. @Aisha Khan thoughts? 

Aisha Khan: Agree on 14 days. Also propose these launch criteria before GA: 
```
- Benchmarks passing on internal slices (zero-regress + perf)
- Privacy review completed and KMS config validated
- Egress compatibility smoke passed (no schema drift)
- Canaries (5% traffic) run for 7 days with no CI red flags
```

Dana O'Neill: Timeline question — do we expect this to add a week to onboarding? Need to inform PM/Ops. Also flagging that legal may require additional data processing review for EEA tenants. 

Aisha Khan: It will add ~5 business days nominally (bench runs + privacy sign-off). We can parallelize canaries with early customer opt-ins to shorten overall calendar. For EEA, add KMS + DPA checklist step. 

Ben Liu: Quick Q on metrics collection: where do we capture the zero-regression eval outputs and thresholds so infra can auto-block an onboard? Should be a machine-readable artifact. 

Aisha Khan: Plan: output a JSON artifact from evals (s3/bench-artifacts/<model>/<ts>/report.json) with keys: quality_deltas, lat_p50_p95_p99, cost_delta, schema_hash. Infra can read that and run a simple rule engine. I'll draft the artifact schema. 

eng-bot: CI: benchmark job started for model "tessera-beta-3" (job id bmk-2026-03-24-11). ETA ~4h. :gear: 

Carlos Martinez: One more: add a nonfunctional requirement for rollout controls — ability to pause by tenant and automatic fallback to previous pinned model if anomaly rate > 0.5% for 10m. Ops needs an escape hatch. 

Aisha Khan: Noted. I'll add auto-fallback thresholds and a manual pause in rollout UI. Next steps: I'll post a short spec doc with the artifact schema + acceptance checklist and tag infra & ops for review. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
